text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai. Mejiro Ardan 
receives a declaration of victory from 
Yaeno Muteki, who has already heard about 
Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing Yaeno Muteki's determination to 
make this the best race for Sakura Chiyono 
O's sake, Mejiro Ardan shows both joy and 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing limits together. Proving that 
to their friends. With that vow in their 
hearts, Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki 
faced the race.
